title: Fixed Blind Dimple Shell and Open Mouth Thimble
description: One newly authored complete side-resting thimble-style sewing prop. A single continuous thick tapered shell joins a real open annular mouth, smooth inner cavity, closed rounded crown and sixty-four shallow blind side dimples. Every dimple has four finite bevel walls and a closed recessed base within the original outer surface; none is a painted dot, separate bead or through hole. A small closed crown recess and a broad lower rim complete the whole hollow cap. The entire original shell is posed at one shallow static resting angle, with horizontal bounds-centred ground datum. Two opaque metal PBR roles, metres Z up. One whole original model zero scenes, not copied needle tips, extracted cup parts or repeated assets. Unlike the prior bulging pin cushion, there are no pins or cloth gores; unlike a hinged compact, this is one deep tapered continuous cup shell with no lid or hinge. Static empty tailoring art only: no finger, needle, puncture resistance, sewing protection, fit, comfort, material grade, real use, load, manufacture or safety capability. Rigging animation and interaction not made.
